title: Navimower 0.4.4-beta22

## Map underlay backend

- Add a dedicated **Map underlay** page to the Navimower Options Flow.
- Add an account-scoped **Google Map Tiles API key** setting. One configured key is shared by all mower entries using the same private-cloud account; the key never needs to be repeated per mower.
- Validate a newly entered Google key by creating a Google Maps Tile API satellite session before saving it.
- Keep an empty password field as **leave the existing key unchanged**, and provide an explicit clear option.

## Google Satellite proxy

- Add authenticated Home Assistant proxy endpoints for Google Satellite 2D tiles and viewport metadata.
- Keep the Google API key and Google session token entirely on the Home Assistant backend; neither is sent in the Navimower map payload or exposed to the Map Card.
- Reuse Google session tokens until their reported expiry and refresh them automatically when needed.
- Do not prefetch or persist Google imagery. Tile responses are streamed through the integration and Google cache headers are passed through to the browser.
- Proxy only the viewport fields needed by the frontend (`copyright` and `maxZoomRects`) so the Map Card can later provide the required Google Maps/data attribution and respect imagery zoom availability.

## Underlay capability metadata

- Add privacy-safe frontend metadata describing whether the mower/site is in Estonia, without adding another exact GPS field.
- Advertise `estonia_orthophoto` and `estonia_hybrid` availability for Estonian mower sites.
- Advertise Google Satellite configured/available state plus authenticated tile/viewport API paths for the future Map Card update.
- The existing validated georeference remains the location source; georeference geometry itself is unchanged.

## Diagnostics and privacy

- Add a `map_underlay` diagnostics section with Estonia underlay availability and Google status such as `api: configured`, session-active state, expiry, last success and a generic last-error code.
- Never export the Google API key or Google session token, including as a redacted placeholder in stored options diagnostics.
- Treat all `*_api_key` fields as sensitive in the shared diagnostics sanitizer.

## Compatibility

- Navimower Map Card does not need to be updated immediately. Existing OSM and Maa- ja Ruumiamet rendering remains unchanged until the companion Map Card beta adds the new editor/runtime choices.
- Georeference behavior from beta20/beta21 is unchanged.
- Rain-control capability behavior from beta21 is unchanged.
